title: Premier Money Market Levels and the Share of Corrective Entries Netted Off a Personal Checking Take-Back
content:
**Clause.** The share of the corrective entries standing on a Personal Checking account that is netted off the take-back moves with the owner's premier money market balance held under Savings & Money Market Accounts and with the owner's card payments under Personal Credit Cards.

1. Where the owner's premier money market balance reaches the tier's relationship maintenance threshold **and** a corrective entry stands on the account, the whole of the corrective entries standing is netted off, that is a share of 1.
2. Where the case above does not apply **and** either the owner's premier money market balance reaches the protection source minimum of 5000.00 **or** the owner has made at least 8 card payments in the last twelve months, half of the corrective entries standing is netted off, that is a share of 0.5.
3. Where neither case applies, no such share is netted off.

The relationship maintenance threshold is the tier's own figure:

| Tier | Relationship maintenance threshold (USD) |
|---|---|
| Access Checking | not offered |
| Student Checking | not offered |
| Everyday Checking | 5000.00 |
| Interest Checking | 15000.00 |
| Premier Checking | 25000.00 |
| Private Client Checking | 250000.00 |

A tier whose threshold reads not offered has no such figure, so the first case cannot arise on it.

**Worked shares on hypothetical inputs.** With corrective entries standing of 90.00:

| Owner's position | Netting worked out on the corrective entries standing |
|---|---|
| Premier money market balance at or above the tier's threshold, a corrective entry standing | 90.00 |
| Premier money market balance of 6000.00, below the tier's threshold | 45.00 |
| Premier money market balance of 200.00, 9 card payments in the last twelve months | 45.00 |
| Premier money market balance of 200.00, 3 card payments | No such share is netted off |

Equality satisfies each threshold: a premier money market balance of exactly 5000.00 reaches the protection source minimum, and exactly 8 card payments meets the card limb of the second case.
